claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The paper formalises SDAD as combining disciplined up-front formalisation with high-velocity implementation through intent capture, machine-readable specification, agentic synthesis, and independent multi-agent verification under human sign-off.
claims.quote: This report formalises Spec-Driven Agentic Development (SDAD) as a synthesis of disciplined up-front formalisation and high-velocity implementation: intent capture, machine-readable specification, agentic synthesis, and independent multi-agent verification under human sign-off.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The paper argues that specification quality becomes the execution fuel for autonomous delivery because agents can ingest substantial Functional Requirement Documents and repository context in one workflow.
claims.quote: Rich context handling and multi-step reasoning now allow substantial Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) and repository context to be ingested in a single workflow, making specification quality the execution fuel for autonomous delivery.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The paper uses evidence on AI-augmented testing and verification to motivate separating synthesis from release authority.
claims.quote: Industrial and research evidence on AI-augmented testing and verification is integrated to motivate separation between synthesis and release authority.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The model extends to team role metamorphosis across engineer, QA, platform, and product functions, plus quantitative governance metrics and staged adoption.
claims.quote: Beyond process description, we extend the model to team role metamorphosis (engineer, QA, platform, and product functions), quantitative governance (Ambiguity Tax, Spec Fidelity, SER, and TCI_agentic with repair multiplier phi), and pragmatic adoption via hybrid estimation and a staged migration blueprint.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The paper positions AI-code as a fourth production paradigm and compares Human-Agile circa 2020 with Agentic-SDAD circa 2026 across artefacts, cadence, accountability, and security posture.
claims.quote: We revisit the historical pendulum between Waterfall and Agile, introduce AI-code as a fourth production paradigm, and compare Human-Agile (circa 2020) with Agentic-SDAD (circa 2026) across artefacts, cadence, accountability, and security posture.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The paper's stated position is that agentic speed does not eliminate engineering discipline but relocates it upstream into specification precision, explicit gates, and auditable provenance.
claims.quote: Overall, the paper argues that agentic speed does not eliminate engineering discipline; it relocates discipline upstream into specification precision, explicit gates, and auditable provenance.
